## Question and method

Describe the question, comparison, hardware, software versions, model, profile, inputs, and grading criteria.

## Results

Include correctness, full task duration, and relevant latency or throughput. Record failures and retries. Link only public or synthetic artifacts.

## Limits

Describe any differences from the published setup and which measurements remain unverified.
